description: TERRAIN-DATA (AI deployment plan P0, DECISIONS D8): the 40kdc 1.0.19 source of the GW layouts was built by point-mirroring half a board and copied the area links, so TerrainManager grouped pieces from opposite sides of the board into one 13.01 terrain area (fixed in the layout JSON, tools/check_terrain_layouts.py). Part 1, take_and_hold_vs_reconnaissance_1: the walls standing in the home-objective ruins area-large-7/8 were parented to the neighbouring area-medium-9/10, so the ruins were 'exposed' (+1 chip, not obscuring, nobody Hidden). Now the chips read LB, 10 Boyz in area-large-7 are Hidden (13.09) and drop off Custodian Guard B's shooting target list from 15.4-23" away; one Custodian moved inside the 15" detection range sees them again. Part 2, reconnaissance_vs_reconnaissance_2: link_group '2' was shared by four separate clusters, so a model in area-medium-29 ignored the area-long-line-35/-43 area 13" south (13.10 exclusion). Now that area obscures every sight line and the Boyz behind it are not targetable. Run on the pre-fix data the THE-fix assertions fail (before evidence).
